title: How Was Your Visit?
instructions: We would like to hear about your most recent visit to our store. Rate how satisfied you were with each part of it, give the visit as a whole a star rating, and tell us how likely you are to recommend us.
items: The range of products on offer
How easy it was to find what you wanted
The time you spent waiting to pay
The price you paid for what you bought

items.text: How likely are you to recommend us to a friend?
